title: Rotokas alphabet, prounciation and language
text: Rotokas is a North Bougainville language spoken by about 4,000 people on the island of Bougainville, an island which is part of Papua New Guinea and which located to the east of New Guinea. There are three main dialects: Central Rotokas, Aita Rotokas and Pipipaia.

title: Rotokas: The World’s “Shortest” Language
text: The Rotokas language is spoken by about 4,000 people on Bougainville Island in Papua New Guinea. It’s known for having one of the shortest alphabets in the world. Its alphabet has only 12 letters and 11 distinct sounds, making it unique.
